title: contracts/screens.json
description: The app's screen contract for screen-contracts' check-screens.mjs and list-screen.mjs. Paths are repo-relative. A testID is <scope>.<element>[.<part-or-key>...] in kebab segments; a {camelCase} segment stands for a data key (one id per item).

references.description: Folder of the approved design frames; a state's reference names a file in it. Default design/screens.

sourceCatalog.description: The source-language catalog the copy keys are checked against. Default <i18nDir>/catalogs/<SOURCE_LANGUAGE>.json.

componentCatalog.description: The component catalogue whose parts the checker derives. Default <contractsDir>/component-library.json when it exists.

components.description: Parts a component derives from its testID, for components outside the catalogue (or to override one).

primaryAction.description: At most `max` of these JSX elements per file: the one obvious action of a screen.

adSlot.description: The ad slot components and the only screens that may render them.

modalRoots.description: Components that keep VoiceOver and TalkBack inside an overlay. Default Modal and Scrim.

retiredKeys.description: Copy keys that must no longer be used, each with the key that replaced it.

ignoredRoutes.description: Route files that are not a screen of their own (a redirect), each with the reason.

route.description: The Expo Router file (route and modal-route).

model.description: The model hook, use-<feature>-model.ts (route and modal-route).

test.description: The view test. Default: the view with .test.tsx.

code.description: Folders (src/features/lists/), shallow folders (src/features/settings/*) or files holding the screen's code. Default: the view's folder.

scopes.description: First testID segments this screen owns. Default: [id].

states.description: Every state, the default first. drawn: false marks a state the design does not draw (Chosen), with its why.

reference.description: The design frame of this state, a file in the references folder.

role.description: What screen readers announce: button, switch, checkbox, header, text, image, list, none ...

component.description: The component that draws it (a library component, AppText, View, FlatList).

kind.description: A variant of the component (secondary, large ...), free text.

text.description: The copy key of its visible text.

a11yLabel.description: The copy key of its accessible name when that differs from the text.

textVia.description: The module that renders the key instead of the screen (a shared formatter).

states.description: Only in these states. Default: every state.

requires.description: A capability the element depends on (an entitlement, a feature flag), free text.

parent.description: Screenshot reach: the accessible element it sits inside (crop-only).

a11yHidden.description: Screenshot reach: hidden from screen readers (crop-only).

coveredBy.description: Screenshot reach: the reachable element whose crop judges its pixels.

checks.description: Screenshot checks for design-visual-parity (bounds, text, fill, crop).
